paras.en: In order to "change lives for the better" and reduce "dependency", George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, introduced the "upfront work search" scheme. Only if the jobless arrive at the jobcentre with a CV, register for online job search, and start looking for work will they be eligible for benefit – and then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly. What could be more reasonable?

paras.en: More apparent reasonableness followed. There will now be a seven-day wait for the jobseeker's allowance. "Those first few days should be spent looking for work, not looking to sign on," he claimed. "We're doing these things because we know they help people stay off benefits and help those on benefits get into work faster." Help? Really? On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness. What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for "fundamental fairness" – protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits. paras.en: Losing a job is hurting: you don't skip down to the jobcentre with a song in your heart, delighted at the prospect of doubling your income from the generous state. It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and you know that support is minimal and extraordinarily hard to get. You are now not wanted; you are now excluded from the work environment that offers purpose and structure in your life. Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared. Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.

paras.en: But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency – permanent dependency if you can get it – supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood. It is as though 20 years of ever-tougher reforms of the job search and benefit administration system never happened. The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment and receive unconditional payments if the disaster happens. Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions. Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited "allowance," conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.

用。此外，句中的并列谓语、破折号引出的递进补充也是常见的句法特征。整体结构规范、典型性
强，是理解复杂条件句和倒装句的优质范例。

句内用情态被动 + 并列状语也是典型搭配。学生掌握此句式后可大量迁移至新闻报道、观点陈述
等语境。典型性较高。
On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives
for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that
demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises
laziness.
第2段，第6句

形容词短语（补充）、后置定语（介词短语 + 定语从句）；从句内部有主语（关系代词）、谓
语、宾语、两个状语（来源和目的）。覆盖了多种常见成分和修饰层级，且表语的扩展方式（分
词、形容词短语、定语从句嵌套）是易错点，适合作为成分划分练习。

第2段，第7句

One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree. Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school. If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so. Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.

作限制性定语的用法,在学术类和说明类文本中极为常见,掌握本句结构后可以大量迁移到类似句子
的理解和写作中。
This leaves today's average law-school graduate with $100,000 of debt on top of
undergraduate debts.
第3段，第4句
"leave + 宾语 + 介词短语(表状态)" 是四六级和考研阅读中常见的使役动词用法，这类结构在真题
中频繁出现，学会后可迁移到 leave sb in/with/without 等多种搭配，具有较高的典型性
Reforming the system would help both lawyers and their customers.
第4段，第1句
动名词短语作主语 + 情态动词谓语 + 宾语的结构在四六级和考研阅读中较为常见，特别是表达观
点、建议或假设时；掌握此句式后可迁移至同类句型（如 "Improving efficiency would reduce
costs"），具有较好的代表性。
Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that
govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
第4段，第2句
并列转折 + 定语从句嵌套是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式；"too...to..." 结构也是常考点；整体结
构具有较强的代表性和迁移价值。
One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.
第4段，第3句
主系表结构配不定式表语是四六级和考研阅读中的常见句式,具有一定代表性,掌握后可迁移到类似
结构,但不属于最高频的复杂句型。

Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school.
第4段，第4句
主系表结构加不定式表语是常见句式，"let sb do" 结构也是高频考点。但整体句式较为简单，没有
复杂从句或特殊结构，作为考试真题的代表性一般。
If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can
sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
第4段，第5句
本句结构高度典型:条件状语从句加主句的复合句式,定语从句修饰主语,被动语态表达建议,均为四六
级和考研常考句式。条件状语从句位于句首、定语从句嵌套在主语中、情态动词加被动语态表达观
点,这些都是真题中反复出现的结构组合,掌握后可大量复用。
The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership
structure of the business.
第5段，第1句
"主系表 + 定语从句修饰主语" 是四六级和考研阅读中的常见句式,特别是用 "reason why" 这种搭配
来解释原因。这种结构具有较高的迁移价值,掌握后可以应用于大量类似句子,典型性较强。
Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law
firm.
第5段，第2句
"Except + 介词短语" 作句首状语 + 简单主谓宾结构,是法律、规章类文本的典型句式,在考试阅读中
较为常见。情态动词表达禁止的用法也具有代表性,掌握后可迁移到类似句型。
There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change
among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates
lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
第5段，第4句
并列主句加宾语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式，there be 句型和动名词作主语也是常考结
构，本句非常典型，掌握后可在大量真题中复用这一分析方法。

In fact, allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms would reduce costs and
improve services to customers, by encouraging law firms to use technology and to
employ professional managers to focus on improving firms' efficiency.
第6段，第1句
本句覆盖动名词短语作主语、并列谓语、及物动词的宾语、方式状语等多种成分，且主语部分包含
动名词的复合结构（宾语 + 不定式宾补），方式状语内部又嵌套多个不定式和动名词，成分丰富
且层次分明，非常适合训练学生识别非谓语动词充当的不同句子成分以及并列结构的划分
After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing
their legal professions.
第6段，第2句
句子成分包含插入性状语、同位语举例、动名词短语作宾语等多种结构，能训练学生识别非核心成
分与核心成分的区别，以及动名词在句中的宾语功能，有一定训练价值。

paras.en: The US $3-million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year's award in March. And it is far from the only one of its type. As a News Feature article in Nature discusses, a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes in recent years. Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs. These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.
paras.zh: 正如Alexander Polyakov在今年三月接受该奖项时所说，这个300万美元的基础物理学奖确实是一项有趣 的实验。而且它远非此类奖项中的唯一一个。正如《自然》杂志的一篇新闻特写文章所讨论的，近年来一 系列为研究人员设立的丰厚奖项已经加入到诺贝尔奖的行列。许多奖项，如基础物理学奖，都是由互联网 企业家们电话号码般庞大的银行账户资助的。这些资助者表示，他们已在各自选择的领域取得了成功,并希 望用自己的财富来让人们关注那些在科学领域取得成功的人。

paras.en: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes – both new and old – are distributed. The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include. But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research – as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson. The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided what he wanted to do with his own money. Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.
paras.zh: 正如《自然》杂志此前指出的,关于科学奖项——无论新旧——如何分配,存在一些合理的担忧。今年启动 的生命科学突破奖对生命科学的涵盖范围持有一种缺乏代表性的观点。但诺贝尔基金会每个奖项最多三名 获奖者且每位必须在世的限制,早已不适应现代研究的合作性质——当涉及承认Higgs玻色子的发现时,关 于谁被忽视的不可避免的争论将证明这一点。当然,诺贝尔奖本身也是由一位非常富有的个人设立的,他决 定了如何使用自己的钱。是时间而非意图赋予了它们正当性。

questions.analysis:
31. The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as____
[ A ] a symbol of the entrepreneurs' wealth.
[ B ] a handsome reward for researchers.
[ C ] a possible replacement of the Nobel Prizes.
[ D ] an example of bankers' investments.

【判型】题干 The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as____ 问的是该奖项 "被视为什么"，是对一
个具体对象的客观定性，没有 infer/imply 等推断信号词。
【拆句】The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as____ 是 "主语 + 系动词 + 介词短语" 的不完整
陈述句，被动语态 is seen as 等同于 "is regarded as"，下划线处由选项补足表语；结构平
铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】The US $3-million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as
Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year's award in March.
正如 Alexander Polyakov 三月份领奖时所说，这项 300 万美元的基础物理奖确实是一次有
趣的尝试。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文说 they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have
succeeded in science——出资者的目的是把注意力引向科学家，而不是用这笔钱来
"象征自己的财富"。选项 a symbol of the entrepreneurs' wealth 把 "使用财富的工具"
偷换成 "财富的象征"。
B)
✓ 正确
The US $3-million Fundamental Physics Prize ↔a handsome reward
those who have succeeded in science ↔for researchers
预判的 "奖金巨额的科研奖" 与 a handsome reward for researchers 完全对应——
handsome 接住巨额，researchers 接住科研获奖者，故选 B。
C)
过度推断
原文 a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes 用
joined 表达 "与诺奖并立"，选项 a possible replacement of the Nobel Prizes 把 "加
入" 升级为 "取代"，属过度推断。
D)
偷换概念
原文 Internet entrepreneurs 指 "互联网企业家"，选项 an example of bankers'
investments 偷换成 "银行家"；且 "investments" 把 "捐赠 / 奖金" 偷换为 "投资"，双
重偷换。
批评者认为新奖项将最有利于____
A) 以营利为导向的科学家。
B) 基于成就的体系。
C) 新奖项的创立者。
D) 同行评审主导的研究。

questions.stem: The critics think that the new awards will most benefit____

options.A: the profit-oriented scientists.
options.C: the founders of the new awards.
options.D: peer-review-led research.

questions.analysis:
【判型】题干 The critics think that the new awards will most benefit____ 要求复述批评者的具体
观点，属于立场观点的细节复现，而非延伸推断。
32. The critics think that the new awards will most benefit____
[ A ] the profit-oriented scientists.
[ B ] the achievement-based system.
[ C ] the founders of the new awards.
[ D ] peer-review-led research.

【拆句】The critics think that the new awards will most benefit____ 主句是 The critics think，
that 引导宾语从句，从句主语 the new awards、谓语 will most benefit 缺宾语，由选项
补足；结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them, say scientists.
科学家们说，这些新奖项不过是奖项幕后之人的自我营销之举。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文从未出现 "profit-oriented scientists（逐利科学家）" 这一群体，更未说他们最受
益，纯属虚构。
B)
与原文相反
原文说新奖项 could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led
research——批评者认为新奖项会扭曲（损害）这一机制，选项却说它最受益，与原文
极性相反。
C)
✓ 正确
those behind them ↔the founders of the new awards
an exercise in self-promotion ↔most benefit
预判 "幕后出资人最受益" 直接锁 the founders of the new awards，那些幕后之人就
是奖项创立者本人。
D)
与原文相反
原文 They do not fund peer-reviewed research 明确说新奖项不资助同行评审研究，
对该研究并无 benefit；选项却称其最受益，正话反说。
希格斯玻色子的发现是一个典型案例,它涉及____
A) 对新奖项的合理担忧。
B) 关于获奖者资格的争议。
C) 现代研究人员的共同努力。
D) 研究成果的展示。

questions.stem: The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves____

options.A: legitimate concerns over the new prizes.
options.C: the joint effort of modern researchers.
options.D: the demonstration of research findings.

questions.analysis:
【判型】题干 The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves____ 不问例子
细节，而问 "这个例子卷入 / 涉及什么"，本质是问例子用来证明哪个观点。
【拆句】The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves____ 主语为长名词短
语 The discovery of the Higgs boson，which 引导限制性定语从句修饰 a typical case，
which 在从句中作主语、involves 后缺宾语由选项补足。
33. The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves____
[ A ] legitimate concerns over the new prizes.
[ B ] controversies over the recipients' status.
[ C ] the joint effort of modern researchers.
[ D ] the demonstration of research findings.

【定位】But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be
living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research – as will be
demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the
discovery of the Higgs boson.
然而，诺贝尔基金会 "每个奖项最多三位获奖者且每位都必须健在" 的规定，早已被现代科
研的协作性质所撑破——这一点将在表彰希格斯玻色子发现时关于 "谁被忽略" 的不可避免
的争论中得到证明。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
legitimate concerns over the new prizes 出自 there are some legitimate concerns
about how science prizes – both new and old – are distributed——但 legitimate
concerns 是用来形容整体的奖项分配问题，与希格斯玻色子的例证无直接关联；希格斯
玻色子直接证明的是 "诺奖规则被撑破"，不是 "新奖项的合理质疑"。
B)
偷换概念
原文争论点是 who is ignored——谁被忽略，焦点在 "漏掉的人"；选项 controversies
over the recipients' status 把焦点偷换成 "获奖者的地位"，地位与是否被忽略不是同一
回事。
C)
✓ 正确
the collaborative nature of modern research ↔the joint effort of modern researchers
预判 "现代科研的协作本质" 与 the joint effort of modern researchers 一一对应，故
选 C。
D)
偷换概念
选项 the demonstration of research findings 利用了原文 as will be demonstrated
by 中的 demonstrated 字面，但原文的 demonstrate 是 "证明（某论点）"，而非 "展
示（研究成果）"；选项偷换为 "研究成果的展示"，与例证目的毫无关联。
根据第4段,关于诺贝尔奖以下哪项是正确的?
A) 历史从未对它们产生过质疑。
B) 它们的持久性证明了它们的公正性。
C) 它们是最具代表性的荣誉。
D) 它们的合法性长期以来一直存在争议。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels?

options.A: History has never cast doubt on them.
options.B: Their endurance has done justice to them.
options.C: They are the most representative honor.
options.D: Their legitimacy has long been in dispute.

questions.analysis:
【判型】题干 which of the following is true of the Nobels? 是典型的 "以下哪项符合原文" 选项级
真伪判断，依据严格限定在 Paragraph 4 内。
34. According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels?
[ A ] History has never cast doubt on them.
[ B ] Their endurance has done justice to them.
[ C ] They are the most representative honor.
[ D ] Their legitimacy has long been in dispute.

【拆句】According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels? 主句为 which
引导的特殊疑问句，According to Paragraph 4 是状语限定信息来源，of the Nobels 修饰
主语 which；结构简单，关键是看清范围限定在第四段。
【定位】The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided
what he wanted to do with his own money. Time, rather than intention, has given
them legitimacy.
诺贝尔奖本身也是由一位大富翁设立的——他自己决定怎么用自己的钱。是时间、而不是初
心，赋予了诺奖合法性。
【选项】A)
过度推断
原文 Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy 承认是时间最终赋予合
法性，但这恰恰反向暗示历史上对其合法性曾有疑虑——否则不需要 "时间来赋予"；选
项 History has never cast doubt on them 用 never 把可能存在的疑虑彻底否决，属
过度推断到绝对极端。
B)
✓ 正确
Time ↔Their endurance
has given them legitimacy ↔has done justice to them
预判 "时间赋予合法性" 与 Their endurance has done justice to them 完全对应——
endurance 接 Time、has done justice to them 接 has given them legitimacy，故
选 B。
C)
与原文相反
原文在第四段反而指出现有奖项（包括诺奖）的代表性问题——Breakthrough Prize in
Life Sciences ... takes an unrepresentative view 及诺奖三人上限不堪现代协作之重；
选项 They are the most representative honor 称诺奖 "最具代表性"，与全段批评意旨
相反，且 "最 representative" 一说原文从未出现。
D)
与原文相反
原文 Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy 是 "已经赋予了合法
性"——是已完成的结论；选项 Their legitimacy has long been in dispute 却称 "合法
性长期处于争议中"，把已尘埃落定的现在完成事实偷换成持续的争议状态。
作者认为新奖项____
A) 不值得公众关注。
B) 会受到不良变化的影响。
C) 有害于研究文化。
D) 尽管受到批评但仍可接受。

options.A: unworthy of public attention.
options.C: harmful to the culture of research.
options.D: acceptable despite the criticism.

questions.analysis:
35. The author believes that the new awards are____
[ A ] unworthy of public attention.
[ B ] subject to undesirable changes.
[ C ] harmful to the culture of research.
[ D ] acceptable despite the criticism.

【判型】题干 The author believes that the new awards are____ 显式询问作者本人的看法，是态
度题的标准句式。
【拆句】The author believes that the new awards are____ 主句 The author believes，that 引导
宾语从句；从句主语 the new awards、系动词 are 后缺表语由选项补足；结构平铺直叙，
无陷阱。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文 it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science 明确
说 "钱和关注流向科学是件好事"，作者认为新奖项值得公众关注；选项 unworthy of
public attention 说 "不值得公众关注"，与作者立场极性相反。
B)
无中生有
subject to undesirable changes 称新奖项会经历 "不良变化"，但原文从未提及 "会
发生不良变化" 这一论断——既无 "changes" 也无 "undesirable" 在 P5 中作用于新
奖项。
C)
与原文相反
原文 it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please 与 It is wise to take
such gifts with gratitude and grace 体现作者认为新奖项对科研文化无害、应当接
纳；选项 harmful to the culture of research 说 "有害于科研文化"，与作者末段评价反
向。注意 that is the culture of research, after all 中 "批评和质疑机制本身才是科研文
化"——批评新奖是研究文化的体现，而不是新奖在伤害文化。
D)
✓ 正确
As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards ↔despite the criticism
It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace ↔acceptable
预判 "尽管存在批评，新奖项仍是可以接受的" 与 acceptable despite the criticism 完
全对应——despite the criticism 接 As much as some scientists may complain，
acceptable 接 wise to take，故选 D。
S E N T E N C E I N S I G H T S · 句子精讲
16 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲
解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。

The US $3-million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting
experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year's award in
March.
第1段，第1句
as 引导方式状语从句加 when 引导时间状语从句的嵌套结构,在四六级和考研阅读中较为常见,尤其
是引用专家观点时常用 as 从句,掌握后可复用到类似句式,具有较高典型性
And it is far from the only one of its type.
第1段，第2句
主系表结构是常见基础句式，但本句表语用介词短语而非形容词或名词，且含 "far from" 这类否定
意味的表达，在考试中有一定代表性但不属于最高频的典型句式。
These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to
use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.
第1段，第5句
并列句加定语从句的组合在四六级和考研阅读中高频出现，且插入语 they say 和不定式作宾语及目
的状语都是典型考点结构，迁移性强
You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs
cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
第2段，第3句
并列主句 + 插入状语从句的结构在四六级和考研阅读中高频出现。双宾语结构和情态动词的使用
也是常考句式。本句结构具有较强的代表性,掌握后可迁移到大量类似句型的理解中。
The goals of the prize-givers seem as scattered as the criticism.
第3段，第1句
主系表结构 + as...as 比较句式在四六级和考研阅读中较为常见，尤其比较结构是高频考点，掌握后
可迁移到类似句型，具有一定代表性，但整体结构偏简单，不如复合句那样高频。

As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how
science prizes – both new and old – are distributed.
第4段，第1句
there be 存在句、as 引导的状语从句、how 引导的宾语从句、被动语态、介词短语后置定语,都是
四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式。整句结构在学术或新闻语体中具有较强代表性,掌握后可以迁移
到大量类似语境
But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must
still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern
research – as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when
it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.
第4段，第3句
主句 + 非限制性定语从句 + 方式状语从句 + 宾语从句 + 时间状语从句的多层嵌套，以及现在完成
时被动、一般将来时被动、情态动词等结构，都是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式；掌握后可直接
迁移到大量真题长难句。
The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had
decided what he wanted to do with his own money.
第4段，第4句
被动语态主句 + 限制性定语从句 + 宾语从句的三层嵌套，是考研和四六级阅读中的高频句式。掌
握本句的分析方法可直接迁移到大量类似长难句。
Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.
第4段，第5句
涵盖主语、谓语、双宾语（间接宾语 them、直接宾语 legitimacy）和插入状语 "rather than
intention"，成分种类较丰富；双宾语结构与插入修饰成分是典型易错点，适合训练成分划分与位
置判断能力。

As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem
clear.
第5段，第1句
让步状语从句加主句的结构在四六级和考研阅读中非常常见，尤其是在议论文和学术文章中。"As
much as"引导让步的用法也是高频考点，学生需要能够识别这类固定搭配并理解其逻辑作用。主句
的主系表结构虽然简单，但"seem + 形容词"这种表达在正式写作中出现频率很高。整体句式具有
较强的代表性和可迁移性。
First, most researchers would accept such a prize if they were offered one.
第5段，第2句

37. Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to____
[ A ] define the government's role in education.
[ B ] safeguard individuals' rights to education.
[ C ] retain people's interest in liberal education.
[ D ] keep a leading position in liberal education.

【判型】题干 report on how to 要求复述国会的具体诉求内容，是对原文事实的客观转述，不涉及
推断。
【拆句】题干是 required that ... 的不完整陈述句，空格处补完 how to 之后的不定式短语；要警惕
国会诉求的内容是 'to + 动词' 的完整短语，不能只看到一两个关键词就下结论。
【定位】In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking
that it identify actions that could be taken by "federal, state and local governments,
universities, foundations, educators, individual benefactors and others" to "maintain national
excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education."
2010 年，国会两党的主要议员致函 AAAS，请它确定可由 '联邦、州和地方政府、大学、基
金会、教育者、个人资助者及其他主体' 采取的行动，以 '维持美国在人文与社会科学学术研
究和教育上的全国卓越地位'。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
define the government's role in education 只截取了 federal, state and local
governments 这一行动主体之一，把国会的整体诉求窄化为 '界定政府的角色'，但原文
中 governments 只是众多主体清单的一员。
B)
无中生有
safeguard individuals' rights to education 涉及的 'individuals' rights' 在原文中找不
到对应概念，国会请求里既无 rights 也无 safeguard，是凭空添加的法律权利话题。
C)
偷换概念
retain people's interest in liberal education 把 maintain excellence （维持卓越地
位）偷换成 retain interest （留住兴趣），后者关注公众兴趣度，前者关注学术领先地
位，二者并非同义。
D)
✓ 正确
maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education ↔
keep a leading position in liberal education
预判要 '保住人文社科教育的领先地位'，keep a leading position in liberal education
在动词、形容词、宾语三个层面都与原文同义对应，是唯一完整对位的选项。

38. According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests____
[ A ] an exclusive study of American history.
[ B ] a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects.
[ C ] the application of emerging technologies.
[ D ] funding for the study of foreign languages.

【拆句】report suggests + 不完整宾语，空格处由选项补出宾语；注意选项中
only/exclusive/greater 这类范围/程度词，对应原文的 also/particularly 时常被偷换。
【定位】To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in
research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems
and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the
encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
为鼓励创新与竞争，该报告呼吁增加对研究的投资，编制能提升学生在 21 世纪解决问题和
有效沟通能力的连贯课程，加大对教师的资金支持，并鼓励学者运用其学识应对当今的重大
挑战。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
an exclusive study of American history 的 exclusive（独占的、唯一的）将原文
particularly American history and American government 的 particularly（尤其、特
别强调）做了范围放大——原文只说 '特别强调' 美国史，并未说 '只学' 美国史。
B)
与原文相反
a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects 强调 '理论性学科'，与原文重点不符——
原文呼吁的是培养 students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively
这类实践能力，是 problem-solving 而非 theoretical。
C)
✓ 正确
encourages the use of new digital technologies ↔the application of emerging technologies
清单 8 项中只有 '新数字技术' 这一条能找到选项一对一的对位，其他选项要么以偏概全
要么无中生有。
D)
张冠李戴
funding for the study of foreign languages 把 increased funding for teachers 中
的 funding 与 advocates greater study of foreign languages 中的 foreign
languages 强行拼接，但原文中 funding 的对象是 teachers，study 的对象才是
foreign languages，二者并非同一句。

questions.stem: The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are____

options.A: supportive of free markets.
options.C: biased against classical liberal ideas.
options.D: cautious about intellectual investigation.

questions.analysis:
【判型】题干 The author implies 用 imply 表明本题需要在段内事实上做一步推断。
39. The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are____
[ A ] supportive of free markets.
[ B ] conservative about public policy.
[ C ] biased against classical liberal ideas.
[ D ] cautious about intellectual investigation.

【拆句】句子简短：作者 implies that professors are + 形容词性表语；只需判断教授对哪类思想呈
何种态度，关注段内 progressive 与 conservative 的对照即可。
【定位】Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive
public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal
ideas – such as free markets and self-reliance – as falling outside the boundaries of routine,
and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
如今，教授们惯常地把进步派的历史解读与进步派公共政策视为正当的研究对象，与此同时
却把保守派或古典自由派的观念——如自由市场和自立——描绘成超出常规、有时是超出正
当智识探究范围的内容。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
supportive of free markets 称教授支持自由市场，但原文恰恰把 free markets and
self-reliance 列为教授排斥的古典自由派观念——立场被反过来了。
B)
与原文相反
conservative about public policy 称教授对公共政策持保守立场，但原文明确教授把
progressive public policy（进步派公共政策）视为正当研究对象，立场是进步派而非
保守派。
C)
✓ 正确
portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas – such as free markets and self-reliance – as
falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation
↔biased against classical liberal ideas
预判教授对古典自由派观念抱有偏见，biased against classical liberal ideas 用 biased
against 精准捕捉了 portray...as falling outside the boundaries 的偏待性，是唯一对
位项。
D)
偷换概念
cautious about intellectual investigation 称教授对智识探究本身谨慎；原文是教授对
一类思想（古典自由派）持排斥态度，并非对智识探究本身谨慎——把对象错位到
intellectual investigation 这个上位概念上。

options.A: Some archaeological sites have always been easily observable – for example, the Parthenon in Athens, Greece; the pyramids of Giza in Egypt; and the megaliths of Stonehenge in southern England. But these sites are exceptions to the norm. Most archaeological sites have been located by means of careful searching, while many others have been discovered by accident. Olduvai Gorge, an early hominid site in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911. Thousands of Aztec artifacts came to light during the digging of the Mexico City subway in the 1970s. 一些考古遗址一直都很容易观察到——例如，希腊雅典的帕特农神庙、埃及吉萨的金字塔以及英格 兰南部的巨石阵。但这些遗址是例外而非常态。大多数考古遗址是通过仔细搜寻找到的,而许多其 他遗址则是偶然发现的。Olduvai Gorge是坦桑尼亚的一处早期人类遗址,1911年被一名蝴蝶猎人 发现,他确实是跌入了它的深谷中。20世纪70年代墨西哥城地铁挖掘期间出土了数千件阿兹特克 文物。
options.B: In another case, American archaeologists René Million and George Cowgill spent years systematically mapping the entire city of Teotihuacán in the Valley of Mexico near what is now Mexico City. At its peak around AD 600, this city was one of the largest human settlements in the world. The researchers mapped not only the city's vast and ornate ceremonial areas, but also hundreds of simpler apartment complexes where common people lived. 在另一个案例中,美国考古学家René Million和George Cowgill花费数年时间系统地绘制了墨西哥 谷地Teotihuacán整座城市的地图,该地靠近现在的墨西哥城。在公元600年左右的鼎盛时期,这座城 市是世界上最大的人类聚居地之一。研究人员不仅绘制了该城市宏大而华丽的祭祀区域,还绘制了数 百座普通人居住的简朴公寓建筑群。
options.C: How do archaeologists know where to find what they are looking for when there is nothing visible on the surface of the ground? Typically, they survey and sample (make test excavations on) large areas of terrain to determine where excavation will yield useful information. options.D: Surveys can cover a single large settlement or entire landscapes. In one case, many researchers working around the ancient Maya city of Copán, Honduras, have located hundreds of small rural villages and individual dwellings by using aerial photographs and by making surveys on foot. paras.en: Music means different things to different people and sometimes even different things to the same person at different moments of his life. It might be poetic, philosophical, sensual, or mathematical, but in any case it must, in my view, have something to do with the soul of the human being. Hence it is metaphysical; but the means of expression is purely and exclusively physical: sound. I believe it is precisely this permanent coexistence of metaphysical message through physical means that is the strength of music.
paras.zh: 音乐对不同的人意味着不同的东西，有时甚至对同一个人在其生命的不同时刻也意味着不同的东西。它可 能是诗意的、哲学的、感性的或数学的,但无论如何,在我看来,它必须与人类的灵魂有某种联系。因此它是 形而上的;但表达的手段却纯粹且完全是物理的:声音。我相信,正是这种通过物理手段传递形而上信息的永 恒共存构成了音乐的力量。这也是为什么当我们试图用语言描述音乐时,我们所能做的只是表达我们对它的 反应,而无法把握音乐本身。

paras.en: Beethoven's music tends to move from chaos to order as if order were an imperative of human existence. For him, order does not result from forgetting or ignoring the disorders that plague our existence; order is a necessary development, an improvement that may lead to the Greek ideal of spiritual elevation. It is not by chance that the Funeral March is not the last movement of the Eroica Symphony, but the second, so that suffering does not have the last word.
paras.zh: 贝多芬的音乐倾向于从混乱走向秩序,仿佛秩序是人类存在的当务之急。对他来说,秩序并非源于遗忘或忽 视困扰我们存在的无序;秩序是一种必要的发展,一种可能通向希腊精神升华理想的改进。《葬礼进行曲》 不是《英雄交响曲》的最后乐章而是第二乐章,这并非偶然,因此苦难并没有成为最后的话语。人们可以这 样诠释贝多芬的许多作品:苦难不可避免,但与之抗争的勇气使生命值得活下去。

partC.analysis:
逐句解析
句前 (N) 即考卷划线句题号，与卷面下划线句一一对应——满分 10 分、每句约 2 分，阅卷把每句切成意群按采
分点给分（★ 为采分点意群）。
【来源】The New York Review of Books（《纽约书评》）2013年4月4日一篇题为 Beethoven
and the Quality of Courage（贝多芬与勇气）的文章。
【主旨】音乐的本质，及贝多芬其人其乐为何需要"勇气"
全文是一篇由演奏家口吻写的随笔：前半谈音乐"形而上的内涵借纯物质的声音表达"这一悖论 this
permanent coexistence of metaphysical message through physical means that is the
strength of music，后半以此为底座评价贝多芬——他革新音乐、思想自由、关心道德与自由，
其音乐"从混乱走向秩序"。作者态度是欣赏、推崇 Beethoven's importance in music has been
principally defined by the revolutionary nature of his compositions。这个基调决定了划线句
里 courage、freedom、suffering 等词都取褒义、庄重义，不可译得轻飘。
(48)Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it
with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him.
(49)Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him,
was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and
of personal expression.
(50)One could interpret much
of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but the courage to fight it renders life
worth living.

【指代】46 句开头 It 指代上一句"形而上内涵＋物质声音并存"这件事
46 句 It is also the reason why 的 It，回指前一句 it is precisely this permanent coexistence
of metaphysical message through physical means that is the strength of music，即"形而上
的信息与物质手段并存"。翻译时若孤立看 It 会断链，须明白它承接的是"音乐这种内涵与声音共
存"，故 46 句意为"正是这一点，也是……的原因"。
47/48/49/50 共用主角 he/his＝贝多芬，全篇统一译为"他/贝多芬"
从第 2 段起 Beethoven's importance in music 确立主角，此后各段 he、his、him 一律指贝多
芬；50 句 the courage to fight it 的 it 指 suffering（苦难）。术语统一：courage 全篇译"勇
气"，freedom 译"自由"，前后保持一致。
(46) It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is
articulate our reactions to it, and not grasp music itself.
【意群】It is also the reason why（主干＋reason 的同位/定语从句引导）★采分→这也是……的原因
难点：It 回指还原＋why 引出原因从句
It 不是"它"，要还原成前句"形而上内涵与物质声音并存"这件事 this permanent coexistence of
metaphysical message through physical means；why 在此引导一个长定语从句，修饰
reason，意为"……之所以如此的原因"，后面整段都在说"什么的原因"。
when we try to describe music with words,（时间状语从句）★采分→当我们试图用语言描述音
乐时
难点：describe...with words＝"用言语描述"
with words 是"用文字/语言"作方式状语，不要漏译；这是承接全文"音乐之内涵难以言传"的关
键，译"用语言/文字去描述音乐"。
all we can do is articulate our reactions to it,（主句（reason why 所修饰的内容））★采分→我们
能做的全部就是表达我们对它的反应
难点：all we can do is (to) do＝"所能做的不过是"；articulate＝清晰说出
all we can do is + 动词原形，是"我们所能做的不过是……"的固定结构，含"仅此而已"的限
定意味。articulate 在此非"灵活的"，而是动词"清楚地表达、说出"（熟词僻义）。to it 的 it
指 music。
and not grasp music itself.（并列谓语（与 articulate 并列，受 all we can do is 统辖））★采分→而
无法把握音乐本身
难点：grasp＝"把握、领会"（非"抓住"）；and not 表转折性对照
grasp 此处取抽象义"领会、把握住"，不译"抓住"。and not 与前面 articulate 形成对照：我
们"只能说出反应"，"却无法把握音乐本身"，music itself 强调"音乐本身"。
【调序】why 长从句整体后置，按汉语"当……时，我们只能……"重排
英文是"It is the reason why [从句]"，汉语不宜说"这是……为什么……的原因"。可把 reason why
处理成"这也正是……的原因"，把 when 时间状语提到主句前，译成"当我们用语言描述音乐时，我
们所能做的只是……而非……"，让时间状语、主句、转折顺次铺开。
【译文】这也正是为什么当我们试图用语言来描述音乐时，我们所能做的只是把自己对音乐的
感受表达出来，而无法真正把握音乐本身。

(47) By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find courage an
essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works.
【意群】By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one,（第一分句（含并列表
语））★采分→据各方所说，他是一个思想自由的人，也是一个勇敢的人
难点：By all accounts＝"据大家所说/普遍认为"；one 替代 person
By all accounts 是固定短语，意为"据各方/普遍说法"，不是"按所有账户"。a courageous one
的 one 代替前面的 person，译"一个勇敢的人"即可，不必重复"人"也行。freethinking＝思想
自由的。
and I find courage an essential quality（第二分句主干（find + 宾语 + 宾补））★采分→而我发现
勇气是一种必不可少的品质
难点：find sth + 名词＝"认为某物是……"（宾补结构）
find courage an essential quality 是"find＋宾语 courage＋宾补 an essential quality"，意
为"认为勇气是一种……的品质"，不是"发现一种品质"。essential＝必不可少的、至关重要的。
for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works.（介词短语作定语＋插入语 let
alone）★采分→对于理解他的作品而言——更不用说演奏了
难点：let alone＝"更不用说"（含递进否定）；the understanding...of his works 被插入语
隔断
the understanding ... of his works 本是一个整体"对他作品的理解"，中间被 let alone the
performance 这个插入语切开。let alone 意为"更别提、更不用说"，表程度递进：理解尚且
需要勇气，演奏就更需要了。还原结构：courage 对"理解他的作品"是必需品质，"更不用说
演奏"。
【调序】插入语 let alone 归位、of his works 提前修饰 understanding
把被插入语隔断的 the understanding ... of his works 先拼回"对他作品的理解"，再把 let alone
the performance 译成"更不用说演奏"放在其后；英文后置的 of his works 在汉语里提到"理解"前
作"的"字定语。
【译文】据大家所说，他是一个思想自由的人，也是一个勇敢的人；而我认为，勇气是理解他
的作品所必不可少的一种品质，更不用说演奏他的作品了。

(48) Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly
following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him.
【意群】Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity（主语核心＋of 后置定语
（动名词1））★采分→贝多芬以极强的力度增大音量的习惯
难点：habit of doing 整个是主语；volume＝音量、intensity＝（力度）强度
这一长串到 was 之前都是主语：核心词 habit，后面 of increasing... 是动名词作定语说明"什么
习惯"。volume 此处指"音量"（不是"体积/卷"），intensity 指演奏"力度的强度"，都是音乐语
境取义。
and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage（of 后置定语的并列部分（动名词2））
★采分→然后又突然接以一个骤然轻柔的乐段
难点：following it 的 it 指前面增大的音量/强音；passage＝（乐曲的）乐段；soft＝（声
音）轻柔
and then ... following 与前面 increasing 并列，同受 habit of 统辖，描述习惯的第二个动作。
it 回指前句"被增强的音量/强音"。passage 在音乐语境是"乐段、段落"，不是"通道"；soft 指声
音"柔和、轻"，不是"软"。abruptly／sudden 都强调"突然"。
was only rarely used by composers before him.（谓语（被动语态）＋时间/范围状语）★采分→在
他之前很少被作曲家使用
难点：被动 was used by＝"被……使用"，宜转主动；before him＝在他之前
was only rarely used by composers before him 是被动语态，汉语顺译"被……"略生硬，可转
主动"他之前的作曲家很少使用"。only rarely＝极少、难得，before him＝在贝多芬之前。
【调序】超长主语压缩前置、被动转主动
of increasing... and then following... 这一长串后置定语全部提到 habit 前，译成"贝多芬……的习
惯"；谓语 was only rarely used by composers 把被动转成主动："在他之前的作曲家极少使用
（这种手法）"，避免"被……所使用"的翻译腔。
【译文】贝多芬习惯于以极强的力度增大音量，随即又突然转入一个骤然轻柔的乐段，这种手
法在他之前的作曲家中极少被采用。

(49) Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with the rights
and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression.
【意群】Especially significant was his view of freedom,（主句（表语前置的倒装））★采分→尤为重要的
是他对自由的看法
难点：完全倒装：表语 Especially significant 提到句首，正常语序是 His view...was
especially significant
本是 His view of freedom was especially significant，为强调把表语 Especially significant
提到了句首形成倒装。翻译时还原成正常语序："他对自由的看法尤为重要/意义重大"。
significant＝重要的、有意义的。
which, for him, was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual:（which 引
导的非限制性定语从句（含插入语 for him））★采分→对他而言，这种看法与个人的权利和责任
相关联
难点：which 指 his view of freedom；for him 是插入语；be associated with＝"与……相
关联"
which 引导非限制性定语从句，先行词是 his view of freedom（他的自由观）。for him 被两
个逗号夹着，是插入语"对他来说"，可单独提出。be associated with＝"与……相联系、相关
联"。the individual＝个人、个体。
he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression.（冒号后的解释说明（对上句的具体
化））★采分→他主张思想自由和个人表达的自由
难点：advocate＝主张、提倡；freedom of thought and of personal expression＝两种
自由并列
冒号在此引出对前文"自由观"的具体解释。advocate＝公开主张、倡导。freedom of thought
and of personal expression 是 freedom of A and (freedom) of B 的省略，即"思想自
由"与"个人表达的自由"两项并列。
【调序】倒装复位、which 从句独立成句、插入语提前
主句还原成"他对自由的看法尤为重要"；which 较长，不前置硬塞，而是独立译成一个分句"（这种
看法）对他而言，与个人的权利和责任相关"，重复"这种看法"承接先行词；for him 提到从句句首
译"对他而言"；冒号保留，后接解释句。
【译文】尤为重要的是他对自由的看法。对他而言，这种自由观与个人的权利和责任紧密相
关：他主张思想自由和个人表达的自由。

(50) One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but
the courage to fight it renders life worth living.
【意群】One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that（主句（One 泛指主语）＋ by
doing 方式状语）★采分→人们可以这样解读贝多芬的大部分作品，即……
难点：One＝泛指"人们"；by saying that＝"通过说……来（解读）"引出宾语从句
One 不是"一个人"，而是泛指"人们/我们"。interpret＝解读、诠释。by saying that... 是
方式状语"通过这样说……"，that 引出后面两个并列分句的内容，译时可处理成"可以这样解
读……即……"。
suffering is inevitable,（saying 的宾语从句之一）★采分→苦难是不可避免的
难点：suffering＝苦难、苦痛；inevitable＝不可避免的
suffering 取名词"苦难、痛苦"，呼应全文"贝多芬音乐从混乱走向秩序、苦难不是终曲"的语境
suffering does not have the last word。inevitable＝必然的、不可避免的。
but the courage to fight it renders life worth living.（but 引导的并列转折分句（宾语从句之二））
★采分→但与之抗争的勇气使生命值得一过
难点：it 指 suffering；render sth + 形容词＝"使某物变得……"；worth living＝值得活
to fight it 的 it 回指前句 suffering（苦难），即"与苦难抗争的勇气"。render 此处不是"给予/
呈现"，而是"使……变得"（render＋宾语＋形容词，熟词僻义）。renders life worth living
＝"使生活变得值得（去）过"，worth＋doing 表"值得做"。
【调序】by saying that 转成"即/也就是说"、render 译"使……变得"
by saying that 不直译"通过说"，而处理成"可以这样解读……即……"或"也就是说"，让方式状语自
然衔接后面的内容。render life worth living 按使役结构译"使生命变得值得度过"，worth living
作"值得活/值得度过"。
【译文】人们可以这样解读贝多芬的大部分作品：苦难是不可避免的，但与苦难抗争的勇气却
使生命变得值得度过。
S E N T E N C E I N S I G H T S · 句子精讲
14 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲
解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。

It might be poetic, philosophical, sensual, or mathematical, but in any case it
must, in my view, have something to do with the soul of the human being.
第1段，第2句
本句展现了考试中常见的并列转折结构（but 连接两个主句）和情态动词的对比使用（might 与
must 的语气差异）。插入语、后置定语、介词短语作状语等都是四六级和考研真题的高频考点。
整体句式具有较强的代表性，掌握后可迁移到大量类似句型。
Hence it is metaphysical; but the means of expression is purely and exclusively
physical: sound.
第1段，第3句
分号连接两个并列主句、用 "but" 转折的句式在四六级和考研阅读中较为常见，有一定代表性。主
系表结构本身是高频句型。但本句的表达风格偏学术抽象（形而上学 vs 物质手段），不如常见议
论文或说明文的句式那样典型；冒号后同位语的用法也稍显特殊。
I believe it is precisely this permanent coexistence of metaphysical message
through physical means that is the strength of music.
第1段，第4句
本句涵盖主谓宾完整结构、宾语从句、强调句式识别、系表结构、多层介词短语作后置定语等多种
成分；强调句是易错高频考点，要求学生能用去框架还原法验证，且句中两个介词短语嵌套（of
metaphysical message through physical means）也是定语划分的常见训练点
It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is
articulate our reactions to it, and not grasp music itself.
第1段，第5句
本句成分丰富且分布典型：主句包含主系表结构，定语从句中包含主谓宾结构和主系表结构，时间
状语从句包含主谓宾结构，还涉及定语从句修饰代词、状语从句插入主谓之间、并列表语等多种成
分配置；练习本句可覆盖多种成分识别场景，训练价值较高。

By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find
courage an essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of
his works.
第2段，第6句
本句覆盖了主系表结构、主谓宾补结构、并列表语、方式状语、目的状语等多种成分类型。第二个
主句的复合宾语结构 find courage an essential quality 是一个值得练习的重点,因为很多学习者容易
把 courage an essential quality 整体误认为宾语,而没有区分出宾语和宾语补足语。这种易错点具有
较好的训练价值。
This courageous attitude in fact becomes a requirement for the performers of
Beethoven's music.
第3段，第1句
主系表结构加后置定语的句式在考试中较为常见，但本句结构过于简单，缺少常考的从句、非谓
语、并列等复杂结构特征，作为典型考试句式的代表性一般，更适合作为基础句型示例。
His compositions demand the performer to show courage, for example in the use
of dynamics.
第3段，第2句
"demand sb to do sth" 的主谓宾补结构是四六级和考研阅读中的常见句式,插入语 "for example" 的
用法也频繁出现。掌握本句结构后,可以迁移到大量类似的要求、建议、命令类动词句式（如
require、ask、advise 等 + 宾语 + 不定式）,代表性较强。
Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then
abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers
before him.
第3段，第3句
主语部分包含所有格定语、介词短语后置定语、并列动名词短语等多种修饰成分,适合练习长主语
的拆解;谓语为被动语态,涉及状语位置和 by 短语的识别;成分种类较丰富,且主语冗长易误判为多个
分句,是较好的成分划分练习材料。

He was not interested in daily politics, but concerned with questions of moral
behavior and the larger questions of right and wrong affecting the entire society.
第4段，第2句
本句覆盖主系表结构、并列表语、并列介词宾语、后置定语等多种成分，且包含承前省略
和"but"连接表语而非分句这一易错点，适合训练学生区分并列连词的连接对象，以及识别系表结
构中的并列表语。
Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with
the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought
and of personal expression.
第4段，第3句
本句结构训练价值较高，尤其适合练习在插入说明和语序变化中寻找主干；时态难度适中，不会把

英语一真题(2014)
Directions:
Write a letter of about 100 words to the president of your university, suggesting how to improve
students’ physical condition.
You should include the details you think necessary. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming ” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
【参考范文 · 108 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
Dear President,
I am a student from the Department of English. I am writing to offer some suggestions on how to improve
students' physical condition.
To begin with, I would suggest that the university build more sports facilities, such as basketball courts and a
swimming pool, so that students have places to exercise. In addition, it would be advisable to organize regular
sports activities, like a monthly running competition, to arouse students' interest. Above all, please ensure that
everyone enjoys at least one free hour for exercise each day.
I sincerely hope these suggestions will be taken into consideration. Thank you for your time.
Yours sincerely, Li Ming
【参考译文】
尊敬的校长：
我是英语系的一名学生。我写信是想就如何改善学生的身体状况提出几点建议。
首先，我建议学校增建更多体育设施，比如篮球场和一个游泳池，让学生有地方锻炼。此外，定期组织体
育活动也很可取，比如每月一次的长跑比赛，以激发学生的兴趣。最重要的是，请保证每人每天至少有一
小时的自由锻炼时间。

我真诚地希望这些建议能被采纳。感谢您抽出时间。
此致敬礼 李明
【第 1 段】身份＋目的一句到位。用 I am a student from the Department of English 自报身份，再用
I am writing to offer some suggestions 直接亮出来信目的，落实了首段‘称呼开门见山亮目的’的方法，
让校长立刻明白信的用意。
【第 2 段】三条措施各配细节。To begin with / In addition / Above all 领起三条措施，分别配上
basketball courts and a swimming pool、a monthly running competition、one free hour for
exercise each day 三个细节，落实‘措施加细节各成一句’，把要求里的必要细节写实，措施不落空。
【第 3 段】谦逊收尾＋规范落款。I sincerely hope these suggestions will be taken into
consideration 表达期望、Thank you for your time 致谢，末尾 Yours sincerely 后落款 Li Ming、通篇
不写地址，落实‘礼貌收尾接落款’与署名硬要求。
A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意
这道题到底要写什么、立意是什么
动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些
是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。
核心任务
给校长写信建议改善学生体质
任务动词是 suggesting（提建议），对象是学生体质：Write a letter of about 100 words to
the president of your university，suggesting how to improve students’ physical condition。一
句话钉死：以学生身份给校长写一封建议信，围绕‘怎样改善学生身体状况’提出可行措施，而不
是抱怨、也不是泛泛谈健康。
读者 · 语域
写给校长，正式恭敬
收信人是 the president of your university，是校方最高负责人，你是普通学生，上行沟通，须
用正式、礼貌、请求式的语域，称呼用 Dear President。署名有硬性规定：Do not sign your
own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming ” instead.，所以落款只能写 Li Ming，绝不能
露真名。

中心立意
请校长采纳改善学生体质的建议
本信交际目的：向校长表明来意并促成改善——suggesting how to improve students’ physical
condition，即用礼貌口吻请校方采纳几条可操作的改善学生身体状况的建议。
要展开的要点
1. 表明身份与写信目的
首段先亮学生身份，再点明来信是为 suggesting how to improve students’ physical condition
提建议，让校长一眼看懂信的用意。
2. 给出具体可行措施
从增加体育设施、开展体育活动、保证每日锻炼时间三个方向给出 1-2 条能真正落地的措施，
避免只喊口号。
3. 为措施补充支撑细节
按要求 You should include the details you think necessary. 给措施配细节，如篮球场、每月长
跑赛、每天一小时，让建议显得可执行。
4. 礼貌表达期望致谢
尾段表达希望建议被采纳并致谢，收束全信、维持得体语气。
S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段
怎么分段、每段写什么、能套哪些句架
按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的 功能
句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

称呼＋亮明写信目的

improve students’ physical condition 提建议。
第 2 段
分点写措施＋配细节
主体段用递进连接词并列 2-3 条改善措施（设施、活动、时间），每条配一个具体细节

第 3 段
礼貌收尾＋落款
尾段表达采纳期望并致谢，末尾 Yours sincerely 后落款 Li Ming，不写地址、不署真名。

R E V I E W · 自检避坑
本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标、容易在哪丢分
按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容
易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。
内容切题
目的＋措施＋细节全覆盖
本题须同时写到写信目的、具体可行措施、支撑细节：措施要真能落地而非空喊，且
照 You should include the details you think necessary. 配上细节，缺任何一环都算内
容不全。
结构连贯
三段清晰＋递进连接
本题正文三段（目的—措施—收尾）各司其职，主体段用 To begin with / In addition
/ Above all 递进并列，避免措施一股脑堆在一句里而层次不清。
语言准确
委婉句式无低级错
本题应多用 I would suggest that.../It would be advisable to.../I sincerely hope... 这类
委婉句式；主谓一致、单复数、时态等低级错误要在誊抄前查掉，语域保持正式礼
貌。
字数格式
落款守规＋不写地址
本题字数须贴近 about 100 words，且必须遵守 Do not write the address. 与只署 Li
Ming 的规定，格式件缺一即丢分。
典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法
署真名或写地址
反面示例：结尾写 Yours sincerely, Zhang Wei，还加上 No. 5 University Road。这违反 Do not sign
your own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming ” instead. 和 Do not write the address.。改
法：落款只写 Li Ming，全信不出现真名与地址。

只喊口号不给措施
反面示例：Exercise is very important. Students should pay more attention to their health. 全是口
号，没告诉校长具体怎么改。改法：To begin with, I would suggest that the university build more
sports facilities, such as basketball courts, so that students have places to exercise. 给出可操作措施
加细节。
命令或抱怨口气
反面示例：You must build a new gym right now, or students will keep getting weaker. 对校长下命
令、带威胁，语域全错。改法：I would suggest that the university build a new gym, which would
help students stay fit. 用委婉建议式。
同义重复凑字数
反面示例：Sports are good. Doing sports is good for students. Sports can make students healthy.
三句一个意思在注水。改法：保留一句主张，改用新细节展开，如 like a monthly running
competition, to arouse students' interest。

Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should
1)describe the drawing briefly,

【参考范文 · 197 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
The two pictures presented above vividly depict a touching scene of mutual care across generations. In the left
one, captioned "Thirty Years Ago", a young mother holds her little daughter's hand as they walk together. In the

right one, labelled "Now", that grown-up daughter tenderly supports her aged mother by the arm, and the
whole cartoon carries the title "Walking Hand in Hand".
Simple as it is, the drawing conveys a profound message about love flowing between family members.
Decades ago the mother nurtured her helpless child; today the child, now an adult, returns that devotion by
caring for her frail parent. Symbolically, it reveals how care and gratitude are passed on in a family, and how
filial duty repays parental love.
In my view, this cycle of affection is exactly what holds a family and a society together. As the pace of modern
life quickens, some young people neglect their ageing parents, leaving them lonely. Therefore, we should
follow the example in the picture: repay our parents with patience and company while there is still time. Only
in this way can the warmth of walking hand in hand be carried from one generation to the next.

上面两幅图生动地描绘了一幕跨越两代人的相互关爱的温情画面。左图题为“三十年前”，一位年轻的母亲
牵着小女儿的手一起走路；右图题为“现在”，那个已长大成人的女儿轻柔地搀扶着年迈母亲的手臂，整幅
漫画取名为“相携”。
画面虽简单，却传递出一个关于亲人之间爱意流动的深刻寓意。几十年前母亲养育无助的孩子；今天已长
大成人的孩子以照料体弱母亲的方式回报这份深情。它象征性地揭示了关爱与感恩如何在一个家庭中代代
相传，孝道又如何回报父母之爱。
在我看来，这种爱的轮回正是维系家庭与社会的纽带。随着现代生活节奏加快，一些年轻人忽视了年迈的
父母，让他们倍感孤独。因此，我们应当效仿画中的做法：趁着还来得及，用耐心和陪伴回报父母。唯有
如此，“相携”的温暖才能一代代传递下去。

读者 · 语域
面向阅卷人的正式书面语
本题是纯议论性大作文，没有具体收信人，读者就是阅卷老师。因此用正式书面语即可：完整
句、正式衔接词、不用缩写口语（如 don't、gonna），也不需要称呼与署名。不必强行设定一
个虚拟读者去写信式开头。
配图要读出
古今对照的相携轮回
配图是 标题为“相携”的漫画，分左右两幅。左侧画面标题为“三十年前”，右边一位年轻的女性
拉着左边一个女孩的手在走路；右侧画面标题为“现在”，左边一位年轻的女性搀扶着右边一位
年长女性的手臂在走路。可写点：三十年前母亲牵着女儿，如今女儿搀扶年迈的母亲——同一
份『相携』在两代人之间轮回，正是亲情反哺、孝道传承的象征。
中心立意
爱与孝在两代间轮回相传
中心论点：这幅 标题为“相携”的漫画 揭示了亲情与感恩在家庭中的代际传递——父母养育子
女，子女长大后反哺父母，孝道薪火相传，正是维系家庭与社会温情的纽带。

1. 画面：母牵女到女扶母
客观描述两幅图的对比：三十年前 右边一位年轻的女性拉着左边一个女孩的手在走路，如今 左
边一位年轻的女性搀扶着右边一位年长女性的手臂在走路，角色恰好互换。
2. 寓意：养育之恩的反哺
点破象征义：当年母亲呵护幼女，今日女儿回报体弱的母亲，画面象征爱与感恩在家庭中的双

3. 评论：尽孝要趁早
谈自己看法与对策：这种反哺之爱正是家庭和社会的黏合剂；针对现实中一些年轻人忽视年迈
父母的现象，呼吁趁父母尚在多陪伴、多回报。

描述到寓意需过渡句
本题从描述段跳到寓意段落差最大，务必用 'Simple as it is, the drawing conveys...'

语言准确

本题涉及『三十年前 vs 现在』对比，描述画面统一用现在时（holds、supports），
讲历史背景才用 nurtured 等过去时；depict、convey、symbolically reveal 等描述漫
画的高频词要用准。
字数格式
控在160到200词内

错；三段分配上让描述段最短，把篇幅留给寓意与评论。
典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法
描述段堆砌琐碎细节
反面示例把描述段写成：『左图女性穿着长款外套、手里提着手提包，女孩穿着连衣裙；右图年轻
女性穿着裙子、挎着包，年长女性穿着毛衣和长裤……』——通篇罗列衣着，占掉大半篇幅却没点出
对比。应改成：只写母亲牵女儿、女儿扶母亲的角色互换与标题，两三句收住。
寓意脱离画面跑题
反面示例：『With the development of society, people are living a better and better life...』——空
喊社会进步，与『母女相携』的画面毫无关系，判为跑题。应改成：紧扣角色互换，写 Decades
ago the mother nurtured her child; today the child cares for her aged mother，点出感恩反哺。

评论空喊无对策
反面示例：『In a word, we should love our parents. It is very important. We must do it.』——三句
都在重复口号、无内容、还注水凑字。应改成：先亮态度，再联系 some young people neglect
their ageing parents 的现实，最后给出 repay our parents with patience and company while there
is still time 的具体对策。
